local effect={
	callbackOnDealDamage = function(self, eff, value, target, dead, death_node)
		if dead then return end
		if value <= 0 then return end
		
		local nb = 0
		for eff_id, p in pairs(self.tmp) do
			local e = self.tempeffect_def[eff_id]
			if e.status == "detrimental" and e.type == "magical" then
				nb = nb + 1
			end
		end
		value = value - (value * eff.numb * nb / 100)
		return value
	end,
}
mod={class={interface={ActorLife={takeHit=function(self,value)self.life=self.life-value;return false,value end}}}}
local function takeHit(self,value,src,death_note)
	local dead, val = mod.class.interface.ActorLife.takeHit(self, value, src, death_note)

	if src and src.fireTalentCheck then src:fireTalentCheck("callbackOnDealDamage", val, self, dead, death_note) end

	return dead, val
end
local cases=0
for _,numb in ipairs({1,3,10}) do for _,nb in ipairs({1,2,5}) do
 local src={tmp={},tempeffect_def={}}
 for i=1,nb do src.tmp[i]={};src.tempeffect_def[i]={status='detrimental',type='magical'} end
 function src:fireTalentCheck(event,value,target,dead,death_note)
  assert(event=='callbackOnDealDamage');assert(target.life==900)
  self.returned=effect.callbackOnDealDamage(self,{numb=numb},value,target,dead,death_note);return self.returned
 end
 local target={life=1000};local dead,value=takeHit(target,100,src,nil)
 assert(value==100 and target.life==900 and src.returned==100-numb*nb);cases=cases+1
end end
print('PASS '..cases..' cases: local callback returns reduced number; fixed takeHit already applied full damage and ignores returned number')
